answer: The strongest single control I know for this is laptop plus phone dual attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 529 keys multiplies the price 529-fold: 58190 POA locked, or 6877 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One atlas of signal, one nebula of cost, one tide of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
